video_title: 纸质笔记还是电子笔记？选择适合自己的记录方式
audience: Chinese-speaking students and professionals comparing note-taking methods
visual_hook: A fair side-by-side choice, not a claim that either method is universally better
subject: On the left, one open cream-paper notebook with a simple black pen. On the right, one generic graphite e-ink writing tablet with a matching stylus. Both are photographed at the same three-quarter angle and equally prominent; the pages and screen show only broad non-readable abstract strokes.
scene_details: Warm apricot on the notebook half and cool teal on the tablet half, clean vertical division, large objects with no tiny accessories. Reserve the upper quarter as a quiet headline band; keep the bottom-right corner free of the tablet's essential details.
